# ITSCtruss

> > Professional manufacturer of aluminum truss systems, stage platforms, and event production equipment based in Guangzhou, China

ITSCtruss specializes in TUV/SGS certified aluminum truss structures using 6061-T6 and 6082-T6 alloys for concerts, exhibitions, and events. Product lines include bolt truss systems, modular stages, circular and triangular trusses, stage barriers, and DMX-controlled lighting equipment.

## Key Topics

- Aluminum Alloy 6061-T6
- Aluminum Alloy 6082-T6
- TUV/SGS Certification
- Bolt Truss Systems
- Stage Roof Truss
- Modular Truss Systems
- Circular Truss
- Triangular Truss
- Rectangular Box Truss
- Stage Platforms
- Crowd Control Barriers
- DMX Lighting Control
- Black Powder-Coated Truss
- Flat Roof Truss
- Stage Equipment
